name: Deadline Monitoring
description: Scans active opportunities daily, sends internal reminders at 30, 14, 7, 3 and 1 days, warns when an application is not ready, and closes expired opportunities.

steps.name: Load active opportunities
steps.description: Read opportunities in verified, scored, pursue_approved, in_preparation, ready_for_submission or awaiting_response with deadline.type = fixed.

steps.name: Compute days remaining
steps.description: Calendar days from today (Africa/Lagos) to deadline.date.

steps.name: Expire passed deadlines
steps.description: Set opportunities whose deadline has passed (and which are not submitted) to expired when autoCloseExpired is true; cancel their scheduled follow-ups.

steps.name: Select reminders
steps.description: Pick records whose days remaining equals a threshold (30, 14, 7, 3, 1) and that have not already received that threshold's reminder.

steps.name: Assess readiness
steps.description: Compare application status and checklist gaps with days remaining; mark "at risk" if fewer than 7 days remain and the application is not in_review or ready_for_submission.

steps.name: Send internal alerts
steps.description: Create in-app Notifications and one daily digest email to INTERNAL_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL (internal staff only).

steps.name: Log run
steps.description: Write counts of checked, reminded, at-risk and expired opportunities.

aiInstructions.reason: Deadline arithmetic and thresholds are deterministic.

integrations.name: Internal notification email
integrations.base44Mapping: Core.SendEmail to the internal address only (no external recipients)

output.description: Reminder notifications, at-risk flags and expired opportunities.

onUnrecoverableFailure: Set the run status to "failed" and stop; never continue past a failed safety check.
Write a WorkflowLog entry with level "error" and the failing stepId.
Send an internal alert to INTERNAL_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL (internal only; never to external recipients).
errorHandling.idempotency: Every run carries a runId. Writes use natural keys (fingerprint, draftId, followUpId) so a retried run cannot create duplicates or send twice.

specificCases.action: Skip it, add redFlag "invalid_deadline" and include it in the digest.
Never expire; list in a "no fixed deadline" section.

approval.rationale: Internal notifications only. No external communication occurs.

logging.redaction: Never log credentials, OAuth tokens or full email bodies. Log IDs and content hashes instead.
